notes.title: SPARKY NEWS
notes.content:
[h3] Hello everyone, how are you? I just wanted to say that we're not done with [b]Sparky: Hills of Death[/b] yet.
 After receiving criticism, we are working on a [b]REMAKE[/b] of the game, where we will restart the entire project with a new story, redesigns and much more!
 It will be a [b]free update[/b] for the current game [b]Sparky: Hills of Death[/b], you can follow it on our social networks, but here is the Teaser Trailer of the Remake version: [/h3][previewyoutube="pB1QL3b7wXQ;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]You can also follow the latest news from the entire studio on our [b]Discord server!
 [/b][url="https://discord.gg/pgpSSRCYY4" buttoncolor="#c737fb"]DISCORD SERVER[/url]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002165/147608370e80f31c497b1c6a9c903ef0e46d9d4e.png"][/img][b] [/b] I hope you will be patient with us for our upcoming projects, updates, and new developments. 
 After fixing some issues in the studio, we are working hard to ensure you have the best experience possible.[/h3]

notes.title: SPARKY: HILLS OF DEATH - UPDATE 1.3
notes.content:
- We fixed Sparky's AI.
- We added the microphone icon.
- We expanded the map.
- We've added notes around the game giving more clues about the story.
- We fixed most of the bugs present in the old version, including the continue button in the pause menu.
- Game pause menu saves settings.
- We've added a "reset" button to the game's pause menu settings.
- Game with DirectX 11 version.

notes.title: SPARKY: HILLS OF DEATH - UPDATE 1.2
notes.content:
[b]PATCH 1.2[/b]
-Void modification and phase 5 shortening
-Continue button fix (apparently)
-Game optimization
-Added +1 easter egg from Vtuber Eeiris
-Enemies in the SparkyHoD minigame are slower
-Mini-Sparky attacks reduce little stamina
-Beast Sparky in the most difficult minigame but he is not unbeatable
-Fixed the audio of the Sparky Plush easter egg crashing the player 
-Fade out of anxiety working (apparently)
-Collision in minigame fixed
-Collision on the portal implemented
-We fixed Sparky's AI preventing him from going through the wall and killing you
-The lantern is now kept in game saves after being collected

notes.title: SPARKY: HILLS OF DEATH - UPDATE 1.1
notes.content:
SPARKY HOD V1.1 IS RELEASED
NEWS
- We added save system in the game
- Your save is saved after exiting the game
- Global Illumination options and reflections enabled
- Optimization (Increase Fps reasonably) 

BUGS FIXED
- Removed the agency cutscene after the janitor's cutscene
- Removed repetitive audio from 1 easter egg
- Bug in a ventilation in the office near Zac's room, where the player could access



In the next updates we will improve the game even further, allowing players with weaker computers to play normally! We will resolve issues related to collisions, microphone warning when Sparky is listening, establishing for the player that talking should not be done!

Bugs and mechanics that will be resolved in the next updates:

- Optimization (we improve even more)
- ESC BUG fixed
- Reduce Monster speeds (minigame)
- Reduce Stamina consumption per Sparky attack (minigame)
- Increase Sparky's running speed (minigame)
- Add speaking microphone icon
- Improve Sparky's AI
- Game input and output options
- We will make the Minigame "Sparky: Hills of Death" easier for players
- We will add more lines of dialogue to the game

Based on new reviews we will:

- Reduce the size of the illusions inside Zac's mind
- Shorten the route to Sparky's final illusion (A few moments before the final chase)

We apologize to all players who witnessed errors, we are working as hard as possible to improve and transform our game to the best possible state! Thank you for the negative reviews and advice we may change in the future, we appreciate everyone who purchased!

notes.title: Sparky: Hills of Death - Chapter 1 OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Today Sparky: Hills of Death was released and we hope you players make the most of the game, discovering secrets and much more!

We ask all players to consider their review on Steam so that our team can view the reviews and improve the game based on the bugs found and each player's experiences!

We thank you all and hope you enjoy Sparky: Hills of Death - Chapter 1
